== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Decipher Product Development hombre [[Bill Martinson]] checks in with [[Aron Eisenberg]] of Star Trek: Deep Space Nine." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
